fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Save signature F3 A1 1F 5F. Checked when the game loads; a missing signature means an empty save

fields.name: bookmark flag
fields.meaning: 1 = a bookmark is stored, so the title menu offers Continue; 0 = no bookmark (cleared when an ending is reached)
fields.evidence: code 4000:B50C (set on bookmark), 4000:2EE9 (cleared at ending), 4000:BA62 (title menu); empty-vs-saved diff 0->1

fields.name: story progress level
fields.meaning: How far the overall story has been unlocked; raised at endings and gates extra content

fields.name: bookmark scene
fields.meaning: Scene (story file) the bookmark resumes in
fields.evidence: code 4000:B4F9 (copied from current scene at bookmark), 4000:2E74 (next scene at ending), 4000:5471 (restored on load)

fields.name: bookmark section
fields.meaning: Section within the scene the bookmark resumes at. The bookmark returns to the start of the section, not to the exact page
fields.evidence: code 4000:2A0E (set on each section jump), 4000:B508; two natural saves 7 pages apart in one section are identical; value 9

fields.name: text speed
fields.meaning: Text speed option: 0 fastest, 1 fast, 2 normal (default), 3 slow
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves (2 vs 1 after setting speed one step faster); code 4000:B5FA menu, timing 4000:2BE2, default 4000:7E52

fields.name: one-hand mode
fields.meaning: One-hand mode option: 0 on, 1 off (default). When on, the Y2 button also advances text
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves (1 vs 0 after toggling the option); code 4000:B606 menu, input 4000:2CC6, default 4000:7E4C

fields.name: extra menu unlock B
fields.meaning: When 1, the title menu shows a sixth entry; set by a story event

fields.name: extra content index
fields.meaning: Number of an extra event or bonus item reached (0 = none). When not 0 the title menu shows a fifth entry; values 16-1F start special scenes, lower values dispatch through a table

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum of the 7 words before it (see checksum row)
fields.evidence: recomputed over every save image (both copies, all groups)

fields.name: overlay picture
fields.meaning: Picture shown over the scene at the bookmark point (FFFF = none)
fields.evidence: code 4000:818F (snapshot from working copy), 4000:5142 (redrawn on load)

fields.name: background picture
fields.meaning: Background picture at the bookmark point (FFFF = none)

fields.name: background setting
fields.meaning: Extra value passed with the background picture (position or style)

fields.name: character picture 1
fields.meaning: Character picture in the first slot at the bookmark point (FFFF = none)

fields.name: character picture 1 setting
fields.meaning: Extra value for character picture 1

fields.name: character picture 2
fields.meaning: Character picture in the second slot (FFFF = none)

fields.name: character picture 2 setting
fields.meaning: Extra value for character picture 2

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum word

fields.name: story variables 0-6
fields.meaning: Seven story counters/flags changed by script commands (add/subtract/set). Variable 1 also holds the number of the last ending when it was in the third ending group (12-14), else 0
fields.evidence: code 4000:3897 (script command), 4000:2E9F; all 0 in natural saves

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum word

fields.name: story variables 7-13
fields.meaning: Seven more story counters/flags

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum word

fields.name: story variable 14
fields.meaning: Story counter/flag 14

fields.name: extra event gate A
fields.meaning: Pending flag for the extra-event scene (0 = extra waiting to run, 1 = settled; default 1)
fields.evidence: code 4000:C7B6 (armed when extra reached), 4000:C2F0 (settled after), checked 4000:C48B and 4000:C208

fields.name: extra event gate B
fields.meaning: Settle flag for the extra record (0 = new extra recorded since last bookmark, 1 = settled; default 1)
fields.evidence: code 4000:C30B (cleared when extra recorded), 4000:B518/2EF5 (settled at bookmark/ending), checked 4000:C483

fields.name: endings reached total
fields.meaning: Number of times any ending has been reached

fields.name: endings group 1 count
fields.meaning: Times an ending numbered 0-6 has been reached (stops at FFFF)

fields.name: endings group 2 count
fields.meaning: Times an ending numbered 7-11 has been reached

fields.name: endings group 3 count
fields.meaning: Times an ending numbered 12-14 has been reached

fields.name: screen effect
fields.meaning: Running screen effect handler at the bookmark point (FFFF = none); restarted on load

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum word

fields.name: text pacing value
fields.meaning: Text timing base set by the story (3 at story start, changed by a script command); picked up when text timing is computed

fields.name: save present flag
fields.meaning: 1 when the save holds game data (enables Delete Data on the title menu); 0 after the data is deleted

fields.name: used episodes A
fields.meaning: 96-bit record of which episodes 00-5F have already been picked by the random episode selection, so they do not repeat; cleared when more than 80 are used
fields.evidence: code 4000:5324 (set bit), 4000:5279 (count and reset); all 11 natural-save entries match their bits

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum word (the bit record skips it)

fields.name: used episodes B
fields.meaning: 32-bit record of which episodes 60-7F have been picked; cleared when more than 25 are used
fields.evidence: code 4000:5324, 4000:5279; all 6 natural-save entries match their bits

fields.name: episode list 1-10
fields.meaning: Episodes chosen at random for this play-through, slots 1-10 (from range 00-5F)

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum word (the list skips it)

fields.name: episode list 11-17
fields.meaning: Slot 11 (from 00-5F) and slots 12-17 (from 60-7F) of the random episode list; slot 17 is kept when an ending re-rolls the list

fields.name: extra items seen
fields.meaning: 32-bit record of which extra items (numbered as at 000D) have been reached

fields.name: picture layer count
fields.meaning: Number of extra picture layers listed at 0150 (0-8; unaligned)

fields.name: next extra event
fields.meaning: Index into the extra-event table for the next automatic extra scene (default 1)

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum word

fields.name: section history
fields.meaning: List of sections visited in the current scene (one byte each), used to page back across sections. Skips the checksum words at 008E,009E,...,013E

fields.name: section history length
fields.meaning: Number of entries in the section history

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum word

fields.name: picture layers
fields.meaning: Up to 8 extra picture layers on screen at the bookmark point, 8 bytes each (picture + three drawing values); skips checksum words at 015E,016E,017E,018E
fields.evidence: code 4000:818F (snapshot), 4000:82E7 (written by script), 4000:5192 (redrawn on load); all 0 in natural saves

fields.name: padding
fields.meaning: No code reads or writes these bytes; zero in all saves
fields.evidence: no references in the game code bank; zero in every save image

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: Last checksum word

fields.name: backup copy
fields.meaning: Second copy of 0000-019F, written right after the first
fields.evidence: copies identical in every valid save; code 4000:7F76 (+0xD0 words)

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written; zero
fields.evidence: all saves zero; writer only covers words 000-19F

fields.name: console owner data
fields.meaning: Console owner profile kept by the system; not touched by this game
fields.evidence: identical (all zero) in every save image
